description: This file defines models and utility functions for integrating the Ace code editor within the application, including loading dependencies, managing editor size, and defining a Range class for text selections.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Represents a text range in the Ace editor, with methods for comparison, extension, and manipulation of text selections.

methods.name: loadAceDependencies
methods.description: Loads all necessary Ace editor dependencies asynchronously, ensuring they are loaded only once.

methods.name: getAce
methods.description: Returns an Observable that resolves to the Ace editor module, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: getAceDiff
methods.description: Returns an Observable that resolves to the Ace diff module, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: updateEditorSize
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the Ace editor based on content and options.
